entities.summary: Turkic Muslim, a notable figure in the history of Kazakhstan, associated with Karluk and Karakhanid States (840–1212). Preceded by Karluk, Oghuz, and Kimek Confederations. Their legacy influenced Sultan Satuq Bughra Khan converts to Islam, founding the Karakhanid dynasty and Mahmud Kashgari compiles the Diwan Lughat al-Turk, first Turkic dictionary.
